title: Veggie Nacho Salad
description: These nachos are loaded with crunchy veggies, including purple cabbage, lettuce, and onions, as well as corned beef for a complete meal that's both fun and satisfying to eat.
ingredients: 1 (10 ounce) bag tortilla chips, or to taste
1 teaspoon vegetable oil, or as needed
1 tablespoon sour cream, or to taste
1 tablespoon chopped green onions, or to taste
1 pinch seasoned salt, or to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Spread tortilla chips on a baking sheet and sprinkle shredded cheese over chips.
Bake in the preheated oven until cheese has melted, about 7 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Add corned beef and cook until heated through, about 5 minutes.
Pile corned beef, lettuce, cabbage, tomato, and onion on top of the chips. Add guacamole, sour cream, and green onions. Sprinkle seasoned salt on top. Toss lightly at the table.
